title: National Coaching Camp Begins for BWF World Junior Championships
indian_angle: This camp at NCE Guwahati is crucial for preparing India's top junior talent for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has commenced a national coaching camp at the National Center of Excellence, Guwahati, to prepare the junior squad for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: BAI Organizes Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This course aims to enhance the skills of Indian badminton coaches, contributing to the development of future national and international players.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) conducted a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14th to 23rd, 2026, focusing on advanced coaching methodologies.

title: BAI Releases Regulations for Inter State Team Championships 2026
indian_angle: These regulations outline the framework for one of India's key domestic team events, fostering competition among states.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has issued the official regulations for the upcoming Inter State Team Championships 2026, detailing rules and guidelines for participation and conduct.

title: Indian Junior Team Camps for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: This camp is vital for honing the skills of India's promising U17 and U15 players ahead of the Badminton Asia Junior Championships.
summary: A coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 was held at the National Center of Excellence, Guwahati, to prepare young talents for international competition.

title: New 3x15 Scoring System Adopted for Domestic Junior Tournaments
indian_angle: This new scoring system will impact the strategy and development of young Indian badminton players in domestic ranking tournaments and national championships.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has implemented a new 3x15 scoring system for domestic ranking tournaments and national championships across the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups, effective from June 30, 2026.
